name: Engage with SROs/SOs of services in the existing landscape who may be affected by change (ORR 2)
conditionsText:
'- not required in something completely managed service driven (supplier built and hosted) 
- not required if brand new service, works in isolation, doesn't interface with anything else
requirementTitle: Engage with SROs/SOs of services in the existing landscape who may be affected by change (ORR 2)
requirementDescription: If the new service or application interacts with existing applications or technologies, the owners of the existing apps or tech are made aware and provide consent.
why: If the new service or application interacts with existing applications or technologies, the owners of the existing apps or tech are made aware and provide consent.
